plugin.name: stark-ai-developer
plugin.longDescription:
stark AI Developer supports product blueprints, specifications, architecture decisions, code search, diagrams, visual reports, repository visuals, agent memory, capability advice, Telegram bots and local Karakeep knowledge. Its open-source instructions and scripts are reviewable.

The OpenAI package has no bundled service or telemetry. Jev optionally sends tasks and public capability cards to TypeSafe using your key. Telegram remote operations can send code or tests and change live data. Karakeep requires a separately installed official MCP and local service; approved sync and curation change saved content. Retrieved knowledge reaches your agent provider under the host data policy. Installation starts no service, scheduler or watcher. The host controls discovery and permissions; external services retain their own access requirements.
capabilities: Turn rough feature ideas into implementation-ready specifications.
Plan whole-product architecture and complete usable delivery increments.
Compare software architecture options with explicit tradeoffs.
Search code structurally with CodeGraph and ast-grep workflows.
Create editable draw.io diagrams from system context.
Create repository documentation and animated README assets.
Curate durable Codex memory with explicit safety boundaries.
Build and maintain bots and Mini Apps on Telegram Serverless.
Recommend available skills and tools for a supplied task with Jev in Codex.
Connect, synchronize approved repository knowledge and curate a local Karakeep collection.
Create and update compact visual HTML reports with complete source exports.
starterPrompts: Turn this feature idea into an implementation-ready specification.
Review the available code context and recommend an architecture with explicit tradeoffs.
Create an editable draw.io diagram for this system.

releaseNotes:
Adds Visual Reports: eight purpose templates, five domain profiles, a shared offline renderer, bounded Markdown input, automatic diagrams and local revision history. Existing recipes and JSON v1 remain supported. Local fixture/browser evidence does not establish native discovery on every host or platform publication.

Architecture Compass 0.13.0 standardizes adopted worktree policies on Worktrunk, reuses suitable existing worktrees and offers installation guidance when needed. An initial read-only comparison aligns the assigned workspace with active harness settings, with manual or authorized automated remedies. Explicit installation refusal preserves compliant Git/host workflows. Existing consumer decisions remain authoritative; native agent behavior and sandbox enforcement require separate qualification.

skills.name: codex-memory-curator
skills.intent: Safely inspect and curate durable Codex memory with explicit scope and host evidence.
skills.cohesion: Provides the memory-safety workflow needed to preserve implementation context without silently rewriting user state.

skills.name: codex-spec-interviewer
skills.intent: Turn an ambiguous software request into a verified, ADR-gated implementation specification.
skills.cohesion: Provides the requirements and decision boundary that makes the toolkit's other developer workflows actionable.

skills.name: animated-readme-logo
skills.intent: Create or validate repository presentation assets for developer documentation.
skills.cohesion: Keeps repository presentation and documentation assets within the developer workflow promise rather than presenting them as a general art tool.

skills.name: architecture-compass
skills.intent: Review or plan ADR-guided architecture changes with bounded execution authority.
skills.cohesion: Adds architecture tradeoffs and governance evidence between a feature idea and implementation work.

skills.name: architecture-zoom
skills.intent: Plan readable whole-product architecture and complete usable delivery increments.
skills.cohesion: Connects the product blueprint and delivery map to bounded architecture review and implementation specifications.

skills.name: codegraph-ast-grep
skills.intent: Set up, update, or diagnose semantic and structural code-search tooling.
skills.cohesion: Supplies repeatable code-context discovery for implementation-ready specifications and structural findings.

skills.name: drawio-diagrams
skills.intent: Create, repair, review, and export editable draw.io diagrams from system context.
skills.cohesion: Turns approved architecture and code context into a concrete, editable developer artifact.

skills.name: telegram-serverless
skills.intent: Build, review and operate Telegram-hosted bots and Mini Apps with explicit local, remote and migration evidence.
skills.cohesion: Extends implementation workflows to a documented hosting provider while preserving project choices, ownership checks and action scope.

skills.name: karakeep-knowledge
skills.intent: Connect and curate persistent development knowledge with approved canonical/draft synchronization and factual session reports.
skills.cohesion: Preserves reusable sources and reviewed repository knowledge for the toolkit's development workflows.

skills.name: jev-capability-advisor
skills.intent: Recommend available skills or MCP tools for a supplied task, or inspect candidates locally.
skills.cohesion: Helps choose an appropriate next workflow from the host-provided catalog without replacing native discovery or execution.

skills.name: visual-reports
skills.intent: Create and update visual reports from one validated model with explicit evidence and local preview.
skills.cohesion: Makes developer findings, comparisons and plans readable while preserving source data and workflow boundaries.
